summary: Implementation plan for a unified, authenticated Remote API v1 (/api/v1/*) exposing all core pipelines (Document & URL Conversion, NLP Analysis, Agent Skills & Formal Logic, MetaAST & Vector DB Chunking, and MCP JSON-RPC 2.0), complete with strict API key authentication, CORS support, OpenAPI 3.0 specification, and an interactive Developer Console & API Explorer in the UI.
